instruction: Capture the visible video frame and store it as 'video_capture.png' in the Desktop folder.

parameters.window_name: Interstellar Movie - Interstellar Movie - Official Trailer - VLC media player

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Variation 3: Filename 'video_capture.png'. Slightly different verb usage (capture/store).
metadata.verification: Task requires taking a VLC screenshot and saving to video_capture.png. Evaluator checks if file exists at /home/user/Desktop/video_capture.png, verifies it is a valid PNG file (via magic bytes), and ensures file size is reasonable for a screenshot (1KB - 10MB).

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly validates file existence at expected path (/home/user/Desktop/video_capture.png)
